input.prompt: Painted 3D comic book frame: physically modelled forms and materials lit by one warm key light, shallow depth of field with a softly blurred background behind sharp objects, then an American comic finish on top: bold black ink contour lines (thick outer, thin inner) and Ben-Day halftone dots only inside the shadows. Palette held to deep blue-black, warm gold, emerald green and signal red. Seen from almost directly above, close up: the flat bed of a 1950s chrome and black bakelite polygraph lie-detector machine on a steel desk at night under one hanging lamp. A wide strip of completely blank pale cream graph paper with a faint fine grid fills the middle two thirds of the picture, its edges straight and parallel to the picture edges, running horizontally from a chrome roller on the left to the right edge, where four thin steel pen arms come in from the right side and rest on the paper, stacked one above another. Below the paper, the machine's black front panel: on the left one large blank chrome rotary dial knob, then three blank toggle switches in a row, each above an empty brass label plate, and a small green and a small red lamp. No people, no text, no letters, no numbers, no writing, no symbols, no logos, no marks on any surface.
